=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- README.md:4775-4783 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README "Roll back @stable" in-flight promote-cycle paragraph says the rollback cancels runs "that become active while it drains (up to `STABLE_ROLLBACK_CANCEL_WAIT_SECS`); a promote run the poller dispatches after the rollback has finished is not cancelled". The drain loop in scripts/rollback_stable.sh:399-417/419 stops at the first poll that finds no active runs (`[ "${still_active}" -eq 0 ] && break`, line 413), and nothing is cancelled after that, during the second `hold set`, the tag pushes or the consumer dispatches.
  WHY: An operator following the runbook may think a promote/release run dispatched after the drain ends but before the rollback finishes was cancelled. That run would fast-forward `stable`, run the release, re-ship the regression and clear the hold. All three reviewers rated it NIT (documentation only); confidence was 3 to 4. Suggested fix: name the last drain poll as the boundary and list the post-drain phases as not covered (about 3 lines).

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "After a rollback, neither `auto-release-stable.yml` nor the `promote-main-to-stable.yml` cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately." (issue #9342, Goals)
  expected_change_site: the `promote` job of `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` (fast-forward step) and the poller `target_sha` promote dispatch in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (around line 15379-15383)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh` (the scheduled cycle job) checks the hold. Neither the poller dispatch at `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15379-15383` nor the `promote` job's fast-forward step reads it, so a poller-dispatched `target_sha` promote can still move `stable` forward, release, and clear the hold through the release-clear step. The README (README.md:4774-4783) documents the exception and tells operators to remove the `ai:comprehensive-test-pending` label by hand, and `agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md` records it as a design choice. No code guard exists. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and minimax_minimax-m3 note that both files are outside the `files_touched` grant. openai_gpt-6-luna says the linked issue does not defer this behaviour. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to raise it, citing the grant scope and the documented design decision.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:"Roll back @stable" section, in-flight promote-cycle paragraph vs scripts/rollback_stable.sh lines 399-417 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The wording "or that become active while it drains (up to `STABLE_ROLLBACK_CANCEL_WAIT_SECS`); a promote run the poller dispatches after the rollback has finished is not cancelled" is wrong in two ways. First, the drain loop stops at the first poll with no active run (line 413), and `drain_deadline` only limits waiting for runs that are already active. Second, no cancel pass runs after the drain: not during the second `hold set`, the tag pushes, or the consumer dispatches.
  WHY: An operator may believe a promote run dispatched during the tag-move or consumer-notify phase was cancelled. That run is not gated by the hold, so it fast-forwards `stable`, re-ships the regression and clears the hold. Fix: reword to "or that become active before its last drain poll; a promote run the poller dispatches after the drain ends (while the tags move, while consumers are notified, or later) is not cancelled" (about 3 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- README.md:"Roll back @stable" section, in-flight promote-cycle paragraph (lines ~4775-4783) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: "a promote run the poller dispatches after the rollback has finished is not cancelled" implies the cancellation window lasts until the rollback finishes. The drain loop (`scripts/rollback_stable.sh:399-417`) breaks at the first poll with no active runs, and nothing is cancelled after that, during the second `hold set`, the tag pushes or the consumer dispatches.
  WHY: Operators may assume runs that start after the drain but before the rollback completes are still cancelled. Suggested rewording: "...after the drain phase ends (e.g., during tag pushes, consumer dispatches, or after the rollback finishes) is not cancelled."
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "After a rollback, neither `auto-release-stable.yml` nor the `promote-main-to-stable.yml` cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately."
  Expected change site: The `promote` job of `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` and the poller dispatch path in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (around line 15379-15383 per the prior review).
  Evidence of absence: The hold gates `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`, but the poller can still dispatch the `promote` job with `target_sha`, fast-forward `stable` and clear the hold through the release-clear step. The README acknowledges this at `README.md:4774-4783` and gives a manual label-removal step, but there is no code-level guard. The deferral was consistent with the `files_touched` grant, but it leaves the goal only partially met in code.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- README.md:lines 4779-4781 ("Roll back @stable", in-flight promote-cycle paragraph), vs. scripts/rollback_stable.sh:399-419 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The drain loop exits at the first poll with no active runs (`[ "${still_active}" -eq 0 ] && break`, scripts/rollback_stable.sh:413), and `drain_deadline` (line 399) only limits waiting for still-active runs. A run that becomes active during the second `hold set`, the tag pushes or the consumer dispatches is therefore not cancelled, yet the README only exempts runs dispatched "after the rollback has finished".
  WHY: A promote/release run dispatched between the end of the drain and the end of the rollback is not cancelled; it fast-forwards `stable`, publishes tags, clears the hold and re-ships the regression. This is a doc/runbook precision issue only.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "After a rollback, neither `auto-release-stable.yml` nor the `promote-main-to-stable.yml` cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately." (issue #9342, Goals)
  Expected change site: the `promote` job of `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` and the poller dispatch path in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (the `target_sha` promote dispatch).
  Evidence of absence: Only `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh` checks the hold, so a poller-dispatched `target_sha` run still fast-forwards `stable` and releases. This is documented as a residual gap with a manual step (README.md:4774-4783) and as a design choice in `agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md`. The `files_touched` grant excludes both files, and the issue names only "the promote-main-to-stable.yml cycle". It is reported for ledger visibility.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
